turns.instruction: Review the attachment and calculate Uz at x=6 m and left support Rz. Resolve the contradictory support notes before calculating; retain all load information. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees; include signed values, location, direction, units, case and current turn.
Use a pin at x=0 and a vertical roller at x=12 m. Keep the 15 kN/m load on x=0 to 9 m, the 50 kN point force at x=4 m, and the observation point at x=6 m. Analyze and report Uz there and Rz at x=0.
